'''Assault Fleet EM4''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[assault fleet]]. It was scheduled to rendezvous with [[Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209/Legends|Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209]] in the [[Kestel system/Legends|Kestel system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
